narr: A push of monsoon moisture fueled an outbreak of thunderstorms across the Mojave Desert. Some storms produced severe weather and flash flooding.
ev: Huffriter Crossing was closed from Hwy 93 to Back Rd.

Hackberry Rd was closed from Hwy 93 to I-40.
The Archibald Wash flooded Pierce Ferry Rd.
Stockton Hill Road was closed from mile marker 36 to Pierce Ferry Road.
